name: RoboCasa
summary: RoboCasa provides 120 kitchen scenes and thousands of objects, many produced with generative models, together with 100+ tasks and large volumes of machine-generated demonstrations. It targets the environmental diversity that real data collection cannot reach, and reports that adding its synthetic data improves policies including on real-world transfer.
innovation: Generative models used to author simulation assets and scene layouts at scale.
Automated demonstration generation across a wide distribution of household layouts.
matters: A central piece of the argument that synthetic diversity can partly substitute for expensive real collection.
limits: Sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich kitchen tasks remains partial.
lineage: The robomimic and robosuite lineage scaled up with generative scene authoring and MimicGen-style demo synthesis.
